SELECT a.id, a.trigger_type, a.trigger_config, a.condition_tree, a.created_by,
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object('id', ac.id, 'branch', ac.branch, 'action_type', ac.action_type, 'action_config', ac.action_config)
    ) FILTER (WHERE ac.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS actions
FROM automations a
JOIN automation_actions ac ON ac.automation_id = a.id
WHERE a.is_active = true
GROUP BY a.id;

INSERT INTO tags (name)
VALUES ($1)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
RETURNING id, name;

INSERT INTO taggables (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

parameters.query: SELECT title, content_html, email_subject, email_body, linked_contract_template_id FROM proposal_templates WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO proposals (opportunity_id, flow_id, title, content_html, total_amount, email_subject, email_body, client_name, client_company_name, client_address, client_email, client_phone, linked_contract_template_id, status, created_at, updated_at, emailed_at)
SELECT o.id,
  (SELECT f.id FROM deal_document_flows f
   WHERE f.is_active = true AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stages s WHERE s.id = f.trigger_stage_id AND s.pipeline_id = o.pipeline_id)
   ORDER BY (f.trigger_stage_id = o.stage_id) DESC, f.id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1),
  $2, $3, COALESCE(o.deal_value, 0), $4, $5,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE($6::text, ''), ' ', COALESCE($7::text, ''))), ''), $8, NULL, $9, $10, $11,
  'emailed', now(), now(), now()
FROM opportunities o WHERE o.id = $1
RETURNING id, public_token;

nodes.name: Generate Proposal For Deal
nodes.notes: Total auto-fills from the triggering deal's own value (COALESCE(o.deal_value, 0)); client_name/company/email/phone snapshot from the deal's linked contact, same as the manual deal-picker auto-fill in the editor. Marked 'emailed' immediately since Send Email fires later in this same run. Now also resolves flow_id the same way manual proposal saves do (Look Up Matching Flow (Save) in Proposals.json) — an active flow for the deal's pipeline, preferring one whose trigger_stage matches the deal's current stage. Without this, the generated proposal has no linked flow, so the viewed/approved stage-advance and any configured Contract Template silently never apply.

    'id', $1::text,

    'opened_at', NULL)
